{{nihongo|'''Jun Inoue'''|井上 順|Inoue Jun|born 21 February 1947}}<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.oh-enter.co.jp/artist/2|title=井上 順|work=Oh Enterprise|language=ja|accessdate=23 Oct 2016}}</ref> is a Japanese ''[[tarento]]'', singer, actor, and comedian. His former stage name is {{nihongo|'''Junji Inoue'''|井上 順之|Inoue Junji}}.
